title: ID0445035-DC/Si-D/RO-[MP / P1 170000127] AC plug not working
description:
Reported Behavior/ Issue: Issue With Charging Initiation At type2 due to
PLC-Error-Flag 'SECC_KF11_AC1_MB_Problem' changed to true
Solution: Install v8.0.5
Notes:  closing the ticket since there has been no charging sessions since - reopen new ticket and possibly change KF11

additional_info.subject: Error at starting charging on type2 170000127
additional_info.body:
Dear support,
We have a complaint from a customer that has errors at starting charging on type2 connector at the charger with serial 170000127.
Below is the message received from the customer
“Dear Sirs, I want to let you know that the middle plug type 2 is not working always. Though I managed to charge very good in the morning om my way to Bucharest, when returning in the evening, the plug didn’t work, disconnecting all the time. At that time there was another vehicle charging at the left power plug. Could this be the reason? Please check because this plug if a well needed one. Thank you and good luck!”
This is a timeframe of a session ended with error
Started
8/12/2025, 06:22:40 PM
Ended
8/12/2025, 06:23:01 PM
And the session from earlier on same day when charging ok:
Could you please check for any errors that could stopped the session right after start.
Cu stima / Best regards  / Mit freundlichen Grüßen,

additional_info.body:
Hello Alexandru, good afternoon.
I apologise for the delay in replying as we faced a surge of tickets.
We have found the root cause of the problem. There is a communication error occuring sometimes between the AC charging point and our PLC.
Since this is in a very outdated version, I would recommend updating the charger to the latest version in order to troubleshoot the component with the latest logs.
Please let me know your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
